state.paragraph: On August 6, 2013, representatives of Party B attended a management presentation at the Boston office of Goodwin Procter with members of Mac-Gray management, representatives of BofA Merrill Lynch and a member of the Transaction Committee.

ledger_rows.Note: Inferred: 20 signers minus Party B, Party C and CSC/Pamplona (submitted) and Party A (recorded; still negotiating NDA) leaves 16 non-submitters; signing dates unstated, so some may be late entrants.
Round 2 opened: Special Committee advanced Party A, Party B, Party C and CSC/Pamplona to management meetings and staged diligence, then revised indications.
Staged disclosure: Party B and Party C (financial) to get broad data-site access; Party A and CSC/Pamplona (strategic) limited access, customer data withheld until later.
Written indication replacing Party C's prior oral $15.00–$17.00 indication.
Signed after non-solicitation terms were agreed 07/27/2013; informational package provided to potentially improve the June 21 proposal.

nda_access.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a party signs a confidentiality agreement, or is given (or denied) data room access, management meetings, projections or other diligence information. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
